title: UNC Skate Club spot list
description: Schema for spots/data/public.json and admin/data/private.json. The file itself determines tier — there is no 'tier' field. See schema.md for prose docs.

id.description: Unique kebab-case slug. Stable across edits — used in URL fragments and as the dedupe key.

name.description: Human-readable name. Shown on the marker popup.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Chapel Hill / Carrboro spots will be roughly 35.9.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Chapel Hill / Carrboro spots will be roughly -79.0.

type.description: Primary obstacle. Matches the filter UI in TODO.md.

area.description: Coarse grouping. 'other' covers anything outside the two towns (Durham edges, etc.).

bust.description: Bust factor. chill = no one cares. caution = depends on time/day. hot = expect to get kicked.

size.description: Free-form size description, e.g. '3-stair', 'knee-high ledge', 'mellow bank'.

notes.description: Plain text. No HTML — Leaflet popups must escape this.

items.description: Relative repo path (e.g. assets/spots/oec-1.jpg) or full https URL. Validated on input — see security notes in schema.md.

verified.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Last time an exec confirmed the spot still exists and is skateable.

added.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). When the spot first entered the list.

submitted_by.description: Optional credit string. From Formspree submissions, will be a Discord handle or first name.
